title: fonttools pyftsubset reduces an OFL font to a title's codepoints as TTF and WOFF2
summary: Subsets JetBrains Mono Bold to the 14 codepoints of 'Type & Motion 2026': cmap equals that set exactly, ASCII drops absent, WOFF2 smaller than TTF smaller than source, repeated runs byte-identical. No variable instancing (no OFL variable font in repo).
